research.question: Blocker 0: WebSiparisFiltre / WebSiparisSayfalama member names, SelectSiparis SOAP body element names, and XML namespaces are not proven. Pack fieldLevelVerified=false. Official PDFs not on disk; network/shell denied so extraction cannot run.

official_sources.observation: Official corporate API page identifies Ticimax in its copyright notice and links destekalani.com as its support system.
Opened official support article links Ticimax-hosted service documentation and publishes SOAP examples for other operations.
Opened 42-page PDF titled TİCİMAX SİPARİŞ SERVİS DÖKÜMANTASYONU on Ticimax's document host. Pages 10–11 contain member tables; pages 17–18 contain C# examples.
Opened Ticimax-branded service documentation v1.4, 15 pages. Pages 9–10 document SelectSiparis and its C# usage.

claims.claim: Public PDF evidence is accessible through live browsing without local extraction.
claims.evidence: https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/SiparisServis.pdf opened successfully with readable text across 42 pages; https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/webservis.pdf opened with 15 pages.

claims.claim: The documented WebSiparisFiltre members are EntegrasyonAktarildi, EntegrasyonParams, IptalEdilmisUrunler, FaturaNo, OdemeDurumu, OdemeTipi, SiparisDurumu, SiparisID, SiparisKaynagi, SiparisKodu, SiparisTarihiBas, SiparisTarihiSon, StrSiparisDurumu, TedarikciID, UyeID, SiparisNo and UyeTelefon.
claims.evidence: https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/SiparisServis.pdf pages 10–11 list these fields; the WebSiparisFiltre initializer on pages 17–18 corroborates their spellings.

claims.claim: C# examples identify WebSiparisSayfalama members as BaslangicIndex, KayitSayisi, SiralamaDegeri and SiralamaYonu; the table contains spelling discrepancies.
claims.evidence: https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/SiparisServis.pdf page 18 uses these four names, whereas page 11 prints BaşlangicIndex and SiralamaDeger. https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/webservis.pdf page 10 corroborates the example spellings.

claims.claim: The documented method signature does not by itself prove SOAP wire element names.
claims.evidence: https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/webservis.pdf page 9 gives SelectSiparis(string UyeKodu, WebSiparisFiltre f, WebSiparisSayfalama s). https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/SiparisServis.pdf page 10 instead labels parameters using the class names. These are signature/table descriptions, not a SelectSiparis SOAP envelope or XSD.

claims.claim: Official examples establish namespace usage for other operations, but do not establish SelectSiparis namespaces.
claims.evidence: https://www.destekalani.com/Icerik/ws-yetki-kodu-yonetimi-web-servis-modulu-649 shows SelectUyeler and SelectUrun examples using http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/, http://tempuri.org/ and http://schemas.datacontract.org/2004/07/. No SelectSiparis-specific envelope was found in the inspected article.

unresolved: No inspected official SelectSiparis SOAP envelope or WSDL/XSD proves its request wrapper and parameter element names.
SelectSiparis-specific namespace qualification for the operation, parameters and nested members remains unverified.
Documentation spelling discrepancies prevent treating the member tables alone as a definitive serialized contract.
Local PDF availability and the existing pack's contents were not inspected; no state was changed.
research.summary: Member names are supported by official C# examples, and live PDF access succeeded. SOAP element names and SelectSiparis-specific namespaces remain unproven. Retain fieldLevelVerified=false.
